audit.why: 50.97% over 569 games. Levels 1-3 are a free zone for a ranged champion against a point-blank Fling, it evens on his first sustain item, and he takes over on two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Jayce|Skill|Singed|Singed|Jayce|Singed|Singed while the captions say Jayce owns 1, 2 AND 3 ('he literally cannot trade back'), it 'evens out' at 4-5, level 6 is his, first item is 'roughly square', and 2+ is his.
audit.why: The chart hands Singed levels 3 and 4-5 in the exact window the text calls free poke, and hands Jayce level 6 in the window the text calls Singed's spike. The packet reference chart, Jayce|Jayce|Jayce|Skill|Singed|Skill|Singed, is what the prose describes.
audit.corrected: Sides re-set to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Singed, Skill, Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive is described only as a slow. Riot: it slows AND GROUNDS. And Fling 'if the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted' — the root is never mentioned. Insanity Potion is called a 'tenacity spike'; Riot's text gives combat stats and Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, no tenacity.
audit.why: Grounding is decisive: To the Skies! is Jayce's only dash and the goo switches it off, so the goo is a wall you walk out of or die in. The Fling-into-adhesive root is the actual kill setup, not the slow. And asserting tenacity from nothing is exactly the kind of invented mechanic the calibration list warns about.
audit.corrected: Grounding, the Fling-into-goo root, and Insanity Potion's real effect (stats + Grievous Wounds via Poison Trail) all stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields call his move speed 'Glory' or 'Glory-speeds'. There is no ability called Glory in Singed's kit — the passive is Noxious Slipstream, which grants speed when he drafts past nearby champions.
audit.why: Fabricated ability name, and the real one matters: Noxious Slipstream triggers off passing CHAMPIONS, so he accelerates by running past you, not on a cooldown you can wait out.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Noxious Slipstream in whys[5], mid and late.

audit.why: Mega Adhesive 17/16/15/14/13s, Fling 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, Insanity Potion 100s flat, Poison Trail has no cooldown at all.

edits.before: Once he picks up boots and a first sustain component his move speed and drain start eating your poke, so the lane levels out here. Keep gate-Q chunking him whenever he shows for CS, but respect that your knockback isn't free: Thundering Blow is your Hammer-form E, so flipping to it spends the stance-swap (and your Hextech Capacitor speed) and drops your Cannon poke for the cooldown. Hold that swap for the moment he Flings — knock him out, then swap back. Don't overstay shoved in: walk too deep and he Flings you into the goo, W-slows you, and Glory move speed means one knockback won't get you out.
edits.after: Once he picks up boots and a first sustain component his move speed and drain start eating your poke, so the lane levels out here. Keep gate-Q chunking him whenever he shows for CS, but respect Mega Adhesive: the goo GROUNDS, so standing in it switches off To the Skies! and you walk out or not at all. Thundering Blow is Hammer-form, so flipping to it spends the stance-swap and drops your Cannon poke for the cooldown. Hold that swap for the moment he Flings — knock him out, then swap back. Walk too deep and he Flings you into the 17s adhesive, which roots you on landing, and Noxious Slipstream speed means one knockback won't get you out.

edits.after: Insanity Potion adds combat stats and makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, while your R is only the stance-swap — level 6 is his.

edits.before: Your Cannon poke still threatens him, but his sustain item and Glory move speed keep the trades roughly square.
edits.after: Your Cannon poke still threatens, but his sustain item and Noxious Slipstream speed keep the trades roughly square.

edits.after: Ground you in Mega Adhesive so To the Skies! dies, then Fling you back into the goo — landing in it roots you outright

edits.before: Insanity Potion is a real stat + tenacity spike for him, while your R is just the Mercury Cannon/Hammer stance-swap you already had — don't try to all-in him through the pot, his sustain and slows win the extended fight.
edits.after: Insanity Potion gives combat stats and makes his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, while your R is just the Mercury Cannon/Hammer stance-swap you already had — don't all-in through a 100s pot, his sustain and slows win the extended fight.

edits.before: This is where he takes over. A 2-item Singed with Rylai's and Riftmaker is a drain-tank you basically can't catch with your one piece of hard CC, and your squishy frame can't out-DPS his sustain in a straight brawl. Your stance-swap speed from Hextech Capacitor lets you keep pace in a chase, but he Flings, poisons, and Glory-speeds out of every commit. Spend your early lead on plates and objectives — don't try to 1v1 a fed Singed, just kite his run-down with Thundering Blow and let your team collapse on him while he's deep.
edits.after: This is where he takes over. edits.after: With Rylai's + Riftmaker he becomes an uncatchable drain-tank: he Flings, grounds you in the goo, and Noxious Slipstreams away from your single knockback, running your team down.

notes: 'Glory' is not a Singed ability — his speed passive is Noxious Slipstream. The 'tenacity spike' claim on Insanity Potion is not in Riot's text and I replaced it with the verified effect (combat stats + Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail). Mega Adhesive's grounding shuts off To the Skies! and the Fling-into-adhesive root were both missing entirely; they are the two facts that decide the lane.
